parts.answer_text: The number of ways in which three-digit numbers can be formed is 5 x 5 x 5 = 125.

parts.part_text: Repetition of the digits is not allowed.

steps.description: Identify that the first digit can be any of the 5 digits.
Calculate the remaining choices for the second and third digits.

parts.final_answer: Therefore, 60 three-digit numbers can be formed without repetition.

difficulty_reasoning: Requires understanding of permutations with and without repetition.
